name: asuma_idle
desc: Pixel art game sprite, side view, full body from horns to feet, standing idle pose facing left in three-quarter view. A short but very muscular anthro dragon man: dark charcoal grey fur, spiky fluffy cheek fur and messy hair fringe, large pointed ears with dark inner ear and small silver piercings, two light-blue translucent crystal horns of the same size with segment lines, light blue eyes with a half-lidded cocky look, two small silver stud piercings above one eyebrow, short rounded dragon muzzle with a smooth tip, small white fang, faint confident smirk with mouth closed, black collar with a silver buckle, broad shoulders, thick arms, big chest and abs, big fluffy dark tail, bare feet with claws, no clothes, smooth plain featureless lower body like a toy figure. Compact stocky proportions, about three heads tall, arms relaxed at his sides. Plain flat background, no other characters.

the character face and chest from the front: eyes, horns, brow piercings, collar, muscles
